# Elm City Photography

> Cinematic, documentary-style wedding and engagement photography based in New Haven, Connecticut. Travel anywhere in Connecticut is included.

Contact: hello@elmcityphotography.com · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/elm.city.photography
Replies within 48 hours.

## Services and pricing

- [Weddings](https://elmcityphotography.com/wedding-pricing/): The Essential $1,400 (6 hours, 1 photographer, 150+ photos), The Story $2,200 (8 hours, 2nd photographer, 300+ photos, engagement session, 5×7 print), The Full Journey $3,200 (up to 12 hours, 2nd photographer, rehearsal dinner up to 2 hours, 400+ photos, engagement session, 8×10 framed print). Sneak peek within 48 hours; full gallery in 4–6 weeks. 25% retainer holds the date.
- [Engagement sessions](https://elmcityphotography.com/engagement-pricing/): The Afternoon $375 (1 hour, 40+ images), The Chapter $695 (2 hours, 60+ images, 5×7 print), The Experience $995 (3 hours, 100+ images, 11×14 print).
- Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and greater New York are available for a small flat travel fee.
